title: Verifier verdict
statement: Given a Boolean flag $e$ and a finite Boolean string $z$, attempt to decode $z$ as a pair $(c,x)$ of Boolean strings; if decoding fails, the verdict is false. Otherwise let $r$ be the number of leading ones in $c$. The verdict is false unless $c$ contains a false entry, $r$ is at most the length of $x$, and either $e$ is false or $r$ equals the length of $x$. When these conditions hold, the verdict is the result of running the evaluator on $c$, starting in the phase that skips $r$ input positions, with the first $r$ entries of $x$ as its computed values, no marked cells, and head position zero.
